summary: Scoped cleanup dispatch (not a plan phase): removed three lemmas whose statements the divergence audit (reports/02_redirect-inertness-divergence-audit.md) machine-checked as FALSE, not merely unproven -- blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem and blockedRedirect_diaNeg_mem (LoopChecking.lean) and blockedRedirect_propAdequate (FrameSoundness.lean), the latter's own ambient-model-reuse proof strategy independently refuted by a 4-world counterexample. Each removal site carries a durable inline comment citing the audit report and the reachable counterexample state; two adjacent doc comments (LoopChecking.lean's 'Witness Disjunct' R1-verdict passage and FrameSoundness.lean's branchPropAdequateIn_s4FC_boxPos_trans_mem docstring) that asserted claims the audit refuted were also corrected in place, since leaving them would misinform the re-plan. Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/ goes from 2 documented sorries to 0 (measured: grep for standalone `sorry` tactic lines returns zero in Tableau/). FrameSoundness.lean's public import of LoopChecking.lean (added in Phase 12 solely for blockedRedirect_propAdequate) was removed and lake shake confirms no remaining need for it in either direction. Full CI green: lake build (project-wide, no errors), lake exe checkInitImports (clean), lake lint (exactly one error, the pre-existing Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Tableau/Saturation.lean baseline, unrelated to this task and unchanged), lake exe lint-style (clean), lake exe mk_all --module ('No update necessary' -- Cslib.lean untouched, concurrent session's territory left alone), lake shake on both touched files (no findings), lake test (all suites built including CslibTests.S4LoopGuardRegression, which per the audit's own note stays valid since the boxed-driver question is orthogonal to this removal). Axiom count unchanged (grep '^axiom' count: 26).
